records.title: DLM-Scope: Mechanistic Interpretability of Diffusion Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
records.reason: The full text analyzes DLM features and decoding-order interventions, which connect to diffusion-language-model behavior, but its main contribution is interpretability and it reports no inference-time compute, memory, or latency reduction. The lineage connection is technically plausible but weak for this efficiency collection.
